about.title: About EUDA
about.p1: Renting was supposed to be temporary. For most of us, it isn't anymore.
about.p2post: on rent. None of it comes back.
about.p3: We believe paying rent should earn you something back. And being a reliable, consistent tenant should earn you even more.
about.p5: We're building this now. If you're a renter who's done watching rent disappear, get on the list.

journey.step1Body: Link your account securely with open banking. Your renter profile is created for you.
journey.step2Body: Move your bills to better deals. What you save goes into your Rent Pot.
journey.step3Body: Bring along friends who rent. Your pot grows faster together.
journey.phase1Milestone: in your Rent Pot by month 6
journey.phase2Body: Being a member makes renting better, not just cheaper.
journey.unlock2: Access to honest and fair landlords with exclusive properties
journey.note: Example amounts. What you save depends on your rent amount, bills and the actions you take with us.

legal.draftBody: This page is a draft. Text in [square brackets] is still to be confirmed by EUDA and its legal adviser.

sections.heading: Who we are
body: EUDA is run by [company legal name], [registered address], [company number]. We are the data controller for the personal data described here.

sections.heading: What we collect
body: When you join the waitlist we collect your email address, the city you enter (optional) and the date you signed up.
[If you add the planned fields: the market and language you signed up in, and the advertising campaign that brought you to the site.]

sections.heading: Why we use it and our legal basis
body: We use your details to tell you when EUDA launches in your city and to send you the updates you signed up for.
Legal basis: [your consent / our legitimate interests — to confirm with our adviser].

sections.heading: Where it is stored and who processes it
body: The website is hosted by Vercel, and waitlist details are stored privately in Vercel's own storage (Vercel Blob). Vercel acts as our processor and only handles the data on our instructions.
Storage region and international transfers: [to confirm, with the safeguards used, for example standard contractual clauses].

sections.heading: How long we keep it
body: [We keep waitlist details until you ask us to remove them, or for [period] after launch, whichever comes first.]

sections.heading: Your rights
body: You can ask to see, correct or delete your data, object to how we use it, or withdraw your consent at any time. Email hello@euda.dev and we will reply within one month.

sections.heading: Cookies and analytics
body: [This site does not set cookies. If cookie-free analytics are added, describe them here.]

sections.heading: Complaints
body: You can complain to the data protection authority: in the UK the Information Commissioner's Office (ico.org.uk), in Spain the Agencia Española de Protección de Datos (aepd.es).

sections.heading: About these terms
body: These terms cover your use of this website, run by [company legal name]. By using the site you agree to them.

sections.heading: The waitlist
body: Joining the waitlist is free and does not create an account or any obligation on either side. EUDA is not yet available, and features, examples and amounts on this site may change before launch.

sections.heading: Tax calculators and examples
body: The tax calculators and the Rent Pot examples are estimates for information only. They are not tax, financial or legal advice. Check your own situation with HMRC, the Agencia Tributaria or a qualified adviser.

sections.heading: Our content
body: The EUDA name, logo and site content belong to [company legal name]. Please don't copy them without permission.

sections.heading: Changes and contact
